entries.subject: BACKPORT: signal: Don't restart fork when signals come in.
entries.change_summary: Check existing signals before expensive copying, register per-fork multiprocess signal bitmap, remove late ordinary restart and copy delayed bits to child before visibility.
entries.electro_finding: The substantive progress/correctness change B014 prepared for: avoids repeatedly discarding expensive fork work for later single-process periodic signals, and records multiprocess events for non-thread children. Already pending signals still cause early ERESTARTNOINTR; late SIGKILL and dying-namespace aborts remain. Initializes multiprocess head in init_signals and new signal_struct, initializes stack node even for unlinked thread/idle paths, registers under current siglock before copying, copies child bitmap before PID visibility, and unlinks on success/failure under siglock. Collector records type>TGID (PGID/SID/MAX), cancels opposing stop/continue bits, and copies bits rather than siginfo queues. It runs only on out_set; ignored/coalesced/overflow short-circuits and realtime metadata require explicit regression tests, not blanket all-signal correctness claims. Prior B014 bool-only fcntl bridge is insufficient now: it collapsed PGID to TGID. New scratch lossless boundary preserves legacy PID(process)→TGID, MAX(thread)→PID, PGID→PGID/SID→SID while keeping NULL-safe iterator/old ownership ABI, avoiding unsafe124 entirely. No commit here fixes124. fork.c is BPF-sealed; struct signal layout and boot/failure paths change, requiring full target validation and explicit overlay, not donor whole-file replacement.
